selection: For test year Y, separately train before each of Y-3,Y-2,Y-1 and validate on that year, purging labels at each year end. Select smallest unweighted mean of three annual MAEs on origin-mean basis; ties follow candidateOrder. Win counts are descriptive only. Refit before Y. No test-based reselection.
inputs: Unchanged six price/volume features and eight stock indicators; identical frozen eligible rows. No disclosure numeric features.
limitations: Previously inspected retrospective periods, not fresh holdout.
Eight stocks, correlated monthly rows, retrospective corporate-action exclusions.
KRX publication availability assumption and raw-price, dividend-excluded targets remain unchanged.
Changing the target does not add information or guarantee improvement.
Overlapping three-year validation windows are not independent replications. No significance claim from win counts.
Archived cross-section proxy, not KOSPI index or total-return benchmark. Includes preferred stocks; excludes zero-volume and changed-share observations.
Unchanged shares do not prove absence of every corporate action. Broad medians reduce but do not eliminate raw-price distortions.
No current survivor list or future listing status filter is used; delisted terminal returns and archive omissions can still bias coverage.

marketFeatures.dailyEligibility: Present on both adjacent nonempty KRX archive dates; positive close, volume and listed shares on both dates; unchanged listed shares. Includes security classes in response; not official index constituents.
marketFeatures.cutoff: origin_date only, before decision_date; never target month
marketFeatures.availability: Same retrospective next-observed-day availability assumption as existing price inputs.
